thread:
sara: Heads-up, I ran an offline A/B on the queue-sculpting heuristic + KV prefetch toggles against the 3-day trace. Thought I'd drop quick notes here before doing a longer sweep. :eyes:
linus: nice, short summary please — what variants and primary metrics?
sara: variants: v2 (current) vs v3 (shape-aware queue + token-budget steering). each run with kv_prefetch on/off. primary metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency for short (<64) and long (>512) contexts, token-cost, kv_hit_rate, kernel-switch count.
rajeev: any perf regressions pop out?
sara: yes — overall token-cost down ~12% on v3+kprefetch, batching_util up ~8%. but p99 for short-context requests increased: v2 p99_short=86ms, v3+kpf p99_short=112ms. p95 stable. kv_hit_rate improved (0.71 -> 0.78). kernel_switch_count increased by ~40% in v3.
maria: hunch: shaping favors packing but causes kernel thrash for tiny requests (switching to larger-kernel path). can we bias kernel selection for short sequences?
linus: can we see the experiment config? want to repro in the trace harness.
sara: posting the minimal config I used:
```
queue_policy: shape-aware
token_budget_target: 48
max_batch_size: 512
kv_prefetch: true
kernel_selection: auto
short_sequence_threshold: 64
```
linus: thanks. try lowering token_budget_target to 24 for short-heavy cohorts and force kernel_selection: prefer-small for requests < 64.
rajeev: also add an A/B slice that disables kv_prefetch to isolate effect. kv helps cost but might change timing for tiny requests if prefetch threads contend.
perf-bot: automated profile summary for v3+kpf on trace segment "chat-1": kernel_switch_count: 42, avg_batch_size: 18, batching_util: 0.65, kv_hit_rate: 0.78, cpu_wait_ms: 6.2, gpu_idle_pct: 4.3
maria: perf-bot numbers look like the kernel switches are the suspect. can we capture a short flame/snapshot for the short request path? even a 200-sample tail would help.
sara: I'll extract a 1k-sample mini-trace of short requests and run kernel-pref bias + token_budget=24. starting now. will post results in ~30m. :thumbsup:
linus: also please include a config where we set `max_batch_size: 64` to see if smaller caps avoid the thrash.
rajeev: add an experiment with `kv_prefetch: opportunistic` (only prefetch when kv_hit_rate_est > 0.6) — may get most of the cost wins without the contention.
sara: noted. running three sims: (A) token_budget=24 + prefer-small, max_batch=64, kp=opportunistic; (B) token_budget=48 + prefer-small; (C) baseline v3+kpf.
perf-bot: queued sims on replay-cluster-2, job ids 2345/2346/2347. ETA ~28m.
maria: if A reduces p99_short back toward baseline while keeping cost down, that would be ideal.
linus: one more ask — capture kernel selection decision log for 1k samples (which kernel chosen, seq_len, batch_size) so we can compute decision entropy.
sara: will include. lmk if you want any extra slices (auth/search).
rajeev: please also tag this run with `ab-harness/queue-sculpt-v3-smallbias` so we can hook it into the A/B dashboard.
sara: done. tagging and kicking off. will post the short-summary thread once sims complete.
linus: thanks — appreciate the quick loop. :rocket:
